message.eden_ld.tour.unavailable: This tab's tour isn't available right now.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.home:
Your summary: level, balance and today's daily quests.

Cards below the summary show what needs you right now: party and guild invites, friend requests, quests to claim and shop purchases to collect. Click a card to go there.

Server news is at the bottom.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.profile:
Your Minestar profile: Minestar activity level (separate from this server's skill tree), rewards and playtime on all servers.

Every level brings something: emoji and sticker slots, extra land claims, free daily rerolls. The track shows what you have and what comes next.

Backgrounds for your page and your player card are in the Wardrobe tab. Who can open your page is set in Settings → Privacy.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.friends:
Your Minestar friends, on every Minestar server, grouped by where they are right now. Click a group's heading to fold it away (it stays folded).

"On this server" lists everyone online here: add them as a friend, invite them to your party (✉) or open their profile.

Incoming and sent requests are in the panel on the right. Search friends by name or by @modpack.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.party:
A small group for playing together. Invite players from here, from Friends or with /invite <name>; the party is created when someone accepts.

Partymates can't hurt each other or each other's pets, and XP from mobs is shared with partymates nearby, with a bonus.

Chat with the party here or with /p <message>. The leader and vice-leaders manage members and settings.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.guild:
A lasting group with a name, a tag and a color. Create one or join by invitation.

The guild bank holds items and coins for everyone; buy more vault tabs, member slots and land claims with it. Click a slot to move one item, shift-click to move the stack, or drag a stack between your inventory and the vault.

Guild waystones set to "Visible to Guild" show up for all members. Chat with the guild here or with /g <message>. Show the tag next to your name in Settings → Privacy.

Guild quests (Quests) are shared by every member and reset daily or weekly. They give guild XP, coins for the guild bank and items mailed to every member. Guild XP also comes from the daily quests members claim. Higher levels draw harder quests and give bonuses (Level).

Officers invite players and handle applications under Recruiting.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.waystones:
Every waystone you have found. Click one to travel there; star your favorites to keep them on the left.

Drag favorites up or down to put them in your own order. Drag a waystone from the right onto the favorites to add it right where you drop it, or a favorite out to the right to remove it. Click a section's heading to fold it away.

After a teleport there is a short cooldown, and you can't teleport while in PvP combat.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.dailies:
A few quests every day; they renew at the time shown in the header.

Don't like a quest? Reroll it (↻): a few rerolls a day are free, then they cost coins. Claim each quest's reward when it's done, and a bonus once every quest of the day is claimed.
gui.eden_ld.hub.help.settings:
Your preferences, saved on the server:

Privacy — who can invite you and see your profile, and your guild tag.
Chat — which messages you see and the mention sound.
Notifications — which news the tabs point out.
Visual — the hub's look and how notifications are shown.

Your mail: rewards from dungeons, raids and duels, auction results, payments, website purchases and messages from the administration.

Open a mail on the left to read it. Claim takes its items (they must fit in your inventory) and coins (straight to your wallet); Claim all takes everything that fits.

Every mail shows when it will be deleted: unclaimed items are lost then, so don't wait too long.

gui.eden_ld.hub.help.moderation:
Staff tools, in a window of their own.

Mail: write a mail to players, to everyone (players who join later too) or to LuckPerms groups, with text in several languages, items and coins. Drafts save themselves while you type. Mail log: what staff sent, how many read and claimed it, and Recall. News: the Home tab's news, in several languages, published with one click. Backgrounds: who may use each profile background, which ones players see locked, and prices.

Players: search anyone who has joined and manage them on tabs (punish with BanHammer, unlocks, dailies, dungeons, emoji slots). Guilds, Parties and Server: disband, reload emojis, the command list and op-only commands.

gui.eden_ld.hub.help.wardrobe:
Everything you can wear: profile backgrounds and hub themes (more categories later).

All shows what you own and what's on sale; Owned and Shop narrow it down. Click a look to see it big, wear it, buy it, or gift it to someone.

A gift is paid by you; the other player gets it at once and a mail tells them it's from you.

gui.eden_ld.hub.help.activities:
Dungeons, raids and mob arenas. Each opens at a level of your skill tree, and each difficulty needs its own level; everyone in a party must have it.

Click an open card to see its lobbies, leaderboard and invites. A card glows when your level has just opened it.

Filter by kind (or pick Duels) and sort by name, required level or type at the top.

Duels: ranked 1v1 and 2v2 duels. Each mode has its own rating; win to climb the leaderboard.

Find match puts you in that mode's queue (you can search both at once). For 2v2, a party of exactly 2 queues together and only its leader can start; on your own you get a random partner.

Below: today's battle rewards, your last 20 matches and the top players of each mode. The duels screen (B) still works too.

gui.eden_ld.hub.help.kits:
Kits are sets of items the server hands out: a starter set, rank kits and more. Each card says when the kit is yours to take: ready now, ready again after a wait, one-time and already taken, or locked (it says how to unlock it).

Preview shows what you get, laid out like your inventory: armor and offhand on the left, the inventory and hotbar beside them. Hover over an item for its details. Claim puts every item in its slot when that slot is free, the rest anywhere in your inventory, and drops what doesn't fit at your feet.

/kits opens this tab too.
